# Company logo restoration ownership — 2026-10-11 (generated)

Status: source evidence verified; independent review, merge, deployment and live Logo.dev artwork QA remain lead-owned.

The brief estimated ~117 names but did not enumerate that subset. This pass accounts for all 196 domains nulled by the [Oct 6 ownership audit](company-logo-domain-ownership-2026-10-06.md): **166 company domains restored / 30 companies kept initials**. The frozen 1,514-row fixture gains **308 identity-qualified logo sources**, from 895 to 1,203; zero previous selections lost. All 192 previous posting bindings are preserved; total bindings: 500. Map: 367 keys, 257 non-null domains, 110 null decisions.

Each accepted posting has an exact employer-heading label and linked LinkedIn company identifier; that profile’s explicit Website field establishes the domain. Public posting and guest job API pages were read without credentials. Stored posting page hashes reproduce the binding through `scripts/build-logo-source-bindings.ts --restore`; the reviewed Website pins and hashes are in `scripts/company-logo-restorations.json`. Homepage title/name similarity and JD mentions do not establish ownership. Homepage responses (including blocked/unavailable ones) are retained as request receipts; the employer profile Website field is the ownership authority. Bright Data’s declared short URL was separately followed over HTTPS to brightdata.com.

Every new identity requires positive structured proof (`collision: true`). A verified source-company binding or owned posting URL grants the source; an unbound same-name LinkedIn posting or conflicting domain/company stays initials. Collision=true here means positive proof required, not a claim that all these names have observed homonyms. Existing initial-only overrides and known wrong-company cases remain protected.

These counts measure resolver selections, not currently displayed correct artwork. A live provider miss still falls back to initials; no live Logo.dev artwork/availability claim is made. No name lookup, secret read, hosted write, migration, production-service mutation or merge was performed.

## Source-reader follow-up

H&R Block’s employer heading is verified, but the existing reader retains `&amp;` in the href identifier (`linkedin:h&amp;r-block` versus `linkedin:h&r-block`). This restoration excludes it; the existing parser was not changed in this PR. The lead can route a separate decoder fix.

## Verification and limits

- Failing-first unit receipts retained; final integrated UI suites: 333 passed, zero failed/skipped/cancelled. Typechecks and scoped lint pass. Default Turbopack production builds pass in the original source worktree and isolated QA copy; the integrated QA copy also builds after merging the shared-pin refactor from master.
- Final sequential capped browser suite: seven passed, zero failed; peak RSS 852 MB, elapsed 37 seconds (3 GB / 600-second caps). Desktop 1440 and mobile 390, light/dark cover grid, drawer and globe rail. Screenshots inspected for restored posting-bound marks and initials.
- Providers: existing local catalog plus intercepted synthetic Logo.dev images. Reverse checks cover unbound namesakes, conflicting identities, JD-only evidence, provider misses, miss caching and uncached transport failure. No live artwork acceptance.
- Connection: the real Next standalone binary served loopback requests; fixture API reads/writes were intercepted. QA-only auth-proxy omission and dependency-root adjustment are recorded in docs.local/p7/qa-provenance.md. Production analysis service and hosted data untouched.
- Contracts: 166 positive-proof identity pins, 308 additional bindings, 500 total bindings, all 192 prior bindings preserved. Documentation records all 196 decisions and six partially bound companies.
- Failed QA setup receipts remain retained: development cold compilation/refresh error and a Webpack-only legacy API type-guard failure. The normal source and isolated production builds and final browser run passed; no unrelated API/runtime repair was included.

Raw public source pages, reviewed Website excerpts, frozen snapshot, generation logs, failed setup receipts and screenshots are retained locally under docs.local/p7/ and are excluded from Git. The committed pins are reviewed evidence declarations; the offline builder does not authenticate profile Website content itself. Independent review, hosted deployment and live provider artwork checks remain separate.
